verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Smithery offers a structured CLI (smithery mcp search/add/list, smithery tool find/call) and APIs that let agents reach MCP servers, but nothing documents operating Smithery itself through natural-language commands. Those CLI commands are fixed syntax with keyword search terms, and supplying tools to agents is a developer building block rather than a natural-language interface to the product, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
